---
title: "Research"
---

MACEDONIA brings together several complementary research fields:

1. Organic synthesis and molecular characterization.
2. Free radicals, antioxidants and electron spin resonance.
3. Computational chemistry and molecular reactivity.
4. Chemical education, experimental learning and teacher preparation.
5. Digital technologies, molecular modeling and 3D printing for science education.
